an7.21:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati sārandade cetiye.
an7.21:1.3: athakho sambahulā licchavī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te licchavī bhagavā etadavoca
an7.21:1.4: satta vo licchavī aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi
an7.21:1.6: evaṃ bhanteti kho te licchavī bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an7.21:2.1: katame ca licchavī satta aparihāniyā dhammā
an7.21:2.2: yāvakīvañca licchavī vajjī abhiṇhasannipātā bhavissanti sannipātabahulā
an7.21:2.3: vuḍḍhiyeva licchavī vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.21:3.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī vajjī samaggā sannipatissanti samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karissanti
an7.21:4.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī vajjī appaññattaṃ na paññāpessanti paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti yathāpaññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattissanti
an7.21:4.2: vuḍḍhiyeva licchavī vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.21:5.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā te sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañca sotabbaṃ maññissanti
an7.21:5.2: vuḍḍhiyeva licchavī vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.21:6.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo tā na okkassa pasayha vāsessanti
an7.21:6.2: vuḍḍhiyeva licchavī vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.21:7.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca tāni sakkarissanti garukarissanti mānessanti pūjessanti tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpessanti
an7.21:7.2: vuḍḍhiyeva licchavī vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.21:8.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikārakkhāvaraṇagutti susaṃvihitā bhavissati
an7.21:8.2: kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṃ vihareyyunti
an7.21:8.3: vuḍḍhiyeva licchavī vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.21:9.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā vajjīsu ṭhassanti imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu vajjī sandississanti
an7.21:9.2: vuḍḍhiyeva licchavī vajjīnaṃ paṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
